name: Return YouTube Subscribers
summary: See exact subscriber counts on YouTube again: on channel pages, under videos, and in search results.
tagline: Exact subscriber counts, back on YouTube.
safariPromotionalText: YouTube rounds every subscriber count. Return YouTube Subscribers puts the full number back on channel pages, watch pages and search results.
description: Since September 2019 YouTube has rounded every subscriber count: "1.2M subscribers" could mean anything from 1,200,000 to 1,299,999. Return YouTube Subscribers puts the full number back.
• Watch pages: the exact count appears under the channel name on every video
• Search results: exact counts on channel results
• Keeps working as you browse; no page reloads needed

YouTube no longer publishes exact counts. The extension reads the ID of the channel you are viewing, asks the Mixerno.space API for its estimated count, and shows that in place of the rounded number. Counts are estimates and can differ slightly from YouTube's internal figure.
• No account, no sign-in, nothing to configure
• No analytics, ads or tracking inside the extension
• The only data sent anywhere is the public ID of the channel you are viewing, to backend.mixerno.space, to look up its count
Return YouTube Subscribers is an independent project and is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

dataDisclosure.summary: The extension sends the public channel ID of the YouTube channel being viewed to backend.mixerno.space to look up its subscriber count. Nothing else is collected, stored or sold.
chromeDataTypes: Web history (the ID of the YouTube channel currently being viewed)
dataDisclosure.singlePurpose: Show exact, unabbreviated subscriber counts on YouTube in place of YouTube's rounded counts.
dataDisclosure.hostPermissionJustification: backend.mixerno.space is the API that returns the estimated subscriber count for a channel ID. youtube.com access is needed to read the channel ID and replace the rounded count on the page.
dataDisclosure.reviewerNotes: To test: open any YouTube channel page (for example https://www.youtube.com/@YouTube) or video. The rounded count under the channel name (e.g. "14.2M subscribers") is replaced with the full number fetched from https://backend.mixerno.space/api/youtube/estv3/<channelId>. No minification or bundling is used; the submitted main.js is the source.
